messages:
Fiona H: kicking off canary for "orion-slim" (int4) with parse_granularity="token". seeing a weird class of failures where escaped quotes and backslashes interact with chunk splits and our quick-quote-append heuristic makes things worse :confounded:
Grant M: can you paste the exact config and one minimal failing trace?
Fiona H: config:
```json
{"model":"orion-slim-int4","parse_granularity":"token","escape_hold":false}
```
stream chunks (simplified):
chunk A: ...\"tool_call\":{\"name\":\"note\",\"args\":\"{\\\"text\\\":\\\"She said: \\\\\\\"Hi\\\\\\\"\\\"\nchunk B: \\\" ,\\\"meta\\\":{}}...
Note the nested escaped quotes and the sequence of backslashes. chunk A ends with an odd number of backslashes before a quote so naive counter logic miscounts quotes.
Harper L: iirc this happens because token-mode splits can occur mid-escape seq, leaving trailing backslashes at chunk end. a simple s.count(\"\") parity test fails when backslashes escape the quote. append-closers/append-quote heuristics then produce invalid JSON or new fields.
Io T: pragmatic heuristic: if a chunk ends with an unpaired backslash (i.e., trailing run of N backslashes where N%2==1) treat it as an escape-continuation and delay parse until next chunk(s) concatenated. call it "escape_continuation_hold". keep it conservative: max buffer 64 bytes or 2 chunks, whichever arrives first.
validator-bot: canary snapshot before fixes: parse_fail=0.71% p50=110ms p95=290ms; block mode parse_fail=0.18% p50=175ms p95=420ms
Grant M: implementation sketch:
```py
def needs_escape_hold(chunk):
    # count trailing backslashes
    m = re.search(r"(\\+)\\Z", chunk)
    if not m: return False
    return len(m.group(1)) % 2 == 1
```
On parse error, if needs_escape_hold(last_chunk) true -> fetch next chunk (up to limit), concat and reparse.
Harper L: tests to add:
- positive: split inside escaped quote (should heal with hold)
- negative: trailing backslash legitimately followed by delimiter token (should not produce schema drift)
- perf: measure added latency for healed requests (avg extra buffer bytes/time).
Io T: caveat: holding increases perceived latency on streaming path; therefore make it opt-in per-model via config `escape_continuation_hold: conservative` and gate by canary percent. recorded metric: extra_buffer_ms and healed_parse_count.
Grant M: will open a small opt-in PR implementing escape_continuation_hold + tests. limit 2 chunks or 64 bytes.
Fiona H: i'll run 1% canary (cb-orion-1805) after PR merges and post results. please also add a replay with cb-orion-1805 sample trace.
validator-bot: action items logged: implement=Grant, tests=Harper, canary_run=Fiona. Monitor: parse_fail_rate, schema_violation_rate, extra_buffer_ms.
Harper L: also add a negative assertion that repaired payload does not add or remove top-level keys (schema comparator).
Fiona H: thanks. tagging security for PII scrub guidance when we attach traces. :lock: :thumbsup:
